about_the_game:
Pathfinder Map Pack: Forest Trails  

In Forests Deep
Riddled with twisting game trails, mysterious glens and ancient trees, the shadowed depths and bewildering paths of the forest may hide adventurers from their foes, or set them up for ambush by the creatures that dwell within! Whether your heroes are pursuing dangerous beasts or seeking out legendary fey, no Game Master wants to spend time drawing underbrush and woodland debris. Fortunately, with Paizo Publishing's latest Pathfinder Map Pack, you don't have to! This line of gaming accessories provides simple and elegant tools for the busy Game Master. Inside, you'll find 18 captivating 5 x 8 map tiles that can be combined into a variety of circuitous forest paths, including:
  • Cave Entrance
  • Fallen Trees
  • Forest Footpaths
  • Fork in the Path
  • Large Clearing
  • Rocky Outcrops
  • Thicket Crossroads
  • Undergrowth-Choked Passages
  • Woodland Glens
Game Masters shouldn't waste their time sketching maps every time characters enter the woods. With Pathfinder Map Pack: Forest Trails, you'll always be ready whenever adventurers pursue woodland mysteries!
While this product has been developed to be used for pathfinder 1E, it is compatible with pathfinder 2.0, 5E and any other ruleset supported by Fantasy Grounds.
This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and features the following additions:
  • All maps resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage
Adapted for Fantasy Grounds by: Wayne Arsenault
